speech.languageHelp: Uses the same source language as Translation.
translation.description: Choose what you hear and the language you want to read.
speech.description: Turn system audio into source subtitles.
subtitles.description: Keep the words clear and the window out of your way.
general.description: Make Desktop Translator fit your daily routine.
about.description: A quiet companion for audio across your desktop.
translation.groqHelp: Uses your Groq API account. The same key can also be used for Groq speech recognition.
translation.googleHelp: Enable the Cloud Translation API in your Google Cloud project. Billing and API access are managed by Google.
translation.deeplHelp: Use a key from a DeepL API Free or Pro plan. A regular DeepL subscription does not include API access.
translation.sourceHelp: The language spoken in your audio
translation.providerHelp: Translate recognized text using your own API account.
translation.missingKey: Add an API key to enable translation. Recognized source text will still appear if translation is unavailable.
translation.transcriptionHelp: Show recognized speech without requesting translations.
speech.providerHelp: Recognizes the source language selected in Translation.
speech.bingHelp: Bing uses the existing speech service and does not require your own API key. Internet access is required.
speech.groqHelp: Groq Whisper requires a Groq API key. Speech and translation share the same saved Groq credential.
speech.geminiHelp: This existing combined speech and translation mode uses Gemini Live. Select Bing or Groq to use the standard translation providers.
speech.captureHelp: Captures audio from your default Windows playback device.
speech.deviceHelp: Play a video, call, or game through your speakers or headphones. If audio stops after a device change, stop and restart translation.
subtitles.sampleHelp: Layout example · local sample text, independent of your current languages and saved appearance.
subtitles.customizeHelp: Font size, opacity, history, original and translated text.
subtitles.behaviorHelp: Always on top, click through, and position locking are in the same customization window.
subtitles.guidance: The customization window includes a live preview. Changes are saved on this computer. Drag and resize the subtitle window normally; use the tray menu to unlock it or turn off click through.
general.themeHelp: Choose a comfortable background for this settings window.
general.languageHelp: Applies to settings and tray controls, independently of subtitle languages.
general.autoStart: Start translation when the app opens
general.autoStartHelp: Begin listening immediately when you launch Desktop Translator.
general.trayHelp: Closing settings leaves the translator running. Use Exit in the tray menu to quit.
general.savingHelp: Selections and switches save automatically. API keys save only when you choose Save key. Changing audio language or provider while listening restarts the active session; interface language does not.
about.product: A Windows desktop companion for real-time bilingual subtitles from videos, calls, games, and live streams.
about.privacyHelp: Audio capture and speech detection happen on your computer. Speech audio is sent to your recognition provider; recognized text is sent to your translation provider. Provider accounts, charges, and retention policies are managed by those services.
about.keyPrivacy: Saved API keys are protected by Windows for your user account. They are never displayed in this settings window.
about.originsHelp: Based on the open-source Kikitan Translator project. Desktop Translator keeps its proven recognition workflow and adds a standalone Windows subtitle experience.
common.footer: Close settings to return to your audio. Controls stay available in the system tray.
credential.stored: Key stored securely for your Windows account
credential.replace: Enter a new key to replace the saved key
credential.draftHelp: Drafts stay while settings are open. Save to keep a key securely.
credential.storageHelp: Saving confirms storage, not provider access.
credential.failed: Save was not confirmed. Check the message above and try again.
credential.timeout: Save was not confirmed. Your draft is still here; try again.
errors.service: The service could not complete the request. Check the details and try again.
errors.authentication: Check your API key and provider account permissions. Original subtitles are retained.
errors.rateLimit: The provider is busy or rate-limited. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.quota: The provider quota has been reached. Check your account usage and billing.
errors.request: Check the selected languages and provider configuration, then try again.
errors.network: The request failed or timed out. Check your network and provider settings. Original subtitles are retained.
errors.save: Settings could not be saved. Check file access and Windows credential protection, then retry.
errors.configuration: Settings could not be loaded. Your existing configuration has been preserved.
native.emptyStopped:
Ready for subtitles
Start translation, then play audio on your desktop.
native.emptyConnecting:
Connecting to speech recognition
Subtitles will appear when speech is recognized.
native.emptyListening:
Listening for speech
Play audio through your Windows playback device.
native.sampleHelp: Local sample · font size and text visibility update here as you edit.
native.opacityHelp: Opacity affects the entire window, including text. Preview stays opaque for readability.
native.click: Click through to the app behind subtitles
native.unlockHelp: Use the tray menu or settings to unlock the window or disable click through.
errors.subtitleSave: Could not save subtitle settings. Check access to your application data folder.
preview.native: Design preview: the native subtitle window is available in the Windows application.
preview.saveError: Preview: settings could not be saved. Your draft is retained.
